title: Find recent files
steps: Ask "What files have I worked on this week?" or "Find my files about <topic>."
expected: It lists the right files from your OneDrive with names you recognize.

title: Find and summarize a document
expected: It finds the right file in OneDrive and gives an accurate summary of its key points.

title: Answer a question from a file
steps: Ask a specific question about a file's contents, e.g. "What's the launch date in the Q4 roadmap deck?"
expected: It answers from the file correctly and says which file it used.

title: Share a file
expected: It shows what will be shared and with whom, and shares only after "confirm". The person can open the file.

title: Email a file
expected: It finds the file in OneDrive, shows the draft with the file or link, and sends only after "confirm". The person can open it.
